title: Star Wars, 8 characters (IV–VI)
source: Star Wars social network 1.0.1, mentions variant (Gabasova 2016)
attribution: Evelina Gabasova (2016), Star Wars social network, version 1.0.1, doi:10.5281/zenodo.1411479 (github.com/evelinag/star-wars-network-data).
notes: Eight named characters, chosen as an introductory example (not a sample). Membership in a film = the character's scene count / the largest scene count in that film (IV 182, V 82, VI 56, all from Luke). Counts come from screenplay scene mentions, not screen time: a mention can refer to an off-screen character, and a zero means no recorded mention in that film.

membership.bin.description: membership of each observation in each set, 0–1

map.bin.description: 2D map of the observations, unit square
